title: A matrix still allows no gap between ranges
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Use the staging site with the Tiered Pricing release (and the Tiered Pricing QA site too, once it exists); production is not needed.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, with two ranges, $0.00 to $100.00 and from $100.01.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click matrix A's name on the Matrices list.
  3. Click Edit.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Matrix A is listed.

Step 2:

  • Matrix A's page opens with two ranges.

Step 3:

  • Each range starts one cent after the one before it ($100.00, then $100.01).
  • The second range's start is not a box that can be typed in.
